Hi Vivek,

Quick ask — leadership availability collapsed for next week and they can only spare 45 minutes for our renewal walkthrough. Can we present a condensed roadmap/QBR that focuses strictly on:
- top 3 ROI wins from the last year

Hi Elena — thanks for the heads-up. We can absolutely compress to a 45-minute walk. Proposed approach (45 minutes, live + recording):

1) 0–5m quick welcome & renewals context (Vivek)
2) 5–20m Top 3 ROI wins + customer metrics (Marissa)
3) 20–35m Performance improvements & Dedicated capacity roadmap (Naomi)
4) 35–43m Pricing path & options (Vivek)
5) 43–45m Quick next steps / DocuSign link & async deep dive scheduling

We’ll record the whole meeting and include a short follow-up appendix for the infra deep dive that Michael can watch or schedule live if needed. I’ll share a one-page pre-read and a proposed 45-minute calendar invite.

Two operational asks for you:
- Can you confirm exec names and whether they prefer a 30-minute slot plus 15-min buffer or a straight 45?
- Any required security attendees (IT/compliance) we should loop in for the recording consent?

I’ve attached a draft agenda and the MA plan you included — we’ll compress before sending to your team.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
